# Builds the C sources generated by TeaVM (gradle generateC) into build/generated/teavm/c
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.15)

# Release by default; this must come before project() (with MSVC, project() sets Debug otherwise)
if (NOT DEFINED CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE OR CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE STREQUAL "")
	set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE Release CACHE STRING "Build type")
endif()

project(monitor_gc C)

set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(GEN ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/build/generated/teavm/c)
set(CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/bin)

if (MSVC)
	# TeaVM detects Windows through _MSC_VER: use MSVC (or clang-cl)
	add_compile_options(/utf-8 /bigobj /W0)
else()
	set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS_RELEASE "${CMAKE_C_FLAGS_RELEASE} -O2")
	add_compile_options(-w)
endif()
if (APPLE)
	add_compile_definitions(_DARWIN_C_SOURCE)
endif()

# all.txt lists every generated .c file
file(STRINGS ${GEN}/all.txt GEN_FILES)
foreach(F IN LISTS GEN_FILES)
	list(APPEND GEN_SOURCES ${GEN}/${F})
endforeach()

add_executable(monitorgc ${GEN_SOURCES})

if (WIN32)
	# nothing to link
elseif (APPLE)
	target_link_libraries(monitorgc m)
else()
	target_link_libraries(monitorgc m rt)
endif()
